title: Loose Juice
description:
Grab a friend and go on a treasure hunting adventure in Loose Juice!

Loose Juice is a co-operative physics platformer where players steer a caravan together across a desert, overcoming obstacles and avoiding traps along the way. Good communication is key: trade your treasure for gear and upgrades, but drive carelessly and you'll damage your goods.

Winner of DARE Academy 2026 and DARE Academy 2026 Audience Choice Award.
